verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe a product-provided starter/welcome board that teaches new users the basics within minutes, a form of guided first-run onboarding. However, no first-party documentation describes a guided walkthrough for setting up a workspace, and the reports are old. One user also noted that some features (e.g. voting) were barely explained. Missing for 10: first-party docs of a guided setup flow, evidence that the walkthrough covers workspace setup (not just board basics), current independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
